:::{#cor-se-rmse-unbiased}
#### For unbiased estimators, SE equals root MSE

If $\hparam$ is [unbiased](#def-unbiased), then its standard error equals its [root mean squared error](#def-rmse):

$$\SE{\hparam} = \sqrt{\mselr{\hparam}}$$

:::

::: proof

This is the solution to @exr-se-rmse-unbiased.

:::
